Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have had Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia (PCP) and no other AIDS defining opportunistic infection present when zidovudine (AZT) therapy was first initiated.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information provided about HIV status, AZT therapy initiation, or PCP history.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have advanced AIDS related complex (ARC).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information provided about AIDS-related complex (ARC) diagnosis or staging.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Antibody to HIV by federally licensed ELISA and confirmed by Western blot analysis.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of HIV antibody testing or confirmation in patient data.
Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have had zidovudine (AZT) therapy interrupted for > 30 consecutive days at any time during AZT therapy or have been off AZT for > 90 days total.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of AZT therapy in patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have had AZT therapy interrupted for 'recurrent' grade 4 toxicity...
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of AZT therapy in patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have visceral or extensive Kaposi's sarcoma requiring therapy or any other malignancy requiring therapy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of malignancy or Kaposi's sarcoma in patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have a history of peripheral neuropathy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of peripheral neuropathy in patient data.
No mention of active opportunistic infection in patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Participation in another research treatment study.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of participation in other studies.
Patient is on metformin, not ddC/ddI.
No mention of substance or alcohol abuse in patient data.

Recap: Patient lacks HIV antibody confirmation, PCP history, and ARC diagnosis required for inclusion. No evidence of AZT therapy, malignancy, or peripheral neuropathy to meet exclusion criteria.
